buzz.title: Daily Buzz
buzz.content:
DAILY BUZZ · FRI NOV 13

━━ LOCAL ━━

1) TC HOLIDAY KICKOFF SPLITS INTO TWO NIGHTS
• Fri Nov 20: Light Up Downtown with cookies, cocoa and shopping
• 5 PM stage show, tree lighting around 6:30
• Sat Nov 21: Light Parade, 6 to 8 PM
• Kids follow Santa down the route "like he's Elvis" (Sara Klebba, DDA)
➜ TAKE: Yes, another tree story this week. Fort Worth got our spruce, but this one stays here, and nobody's putting it on a trailer.
➜ BAIT: Tree lighting Friday or parade Saturday?

2) 72ND MANCELONA BUCK POLE
• Firearm deer season opens Sunday, Nov 15
• The pole opens at daybreak Sunday and closes Mon Nov 16 at 6:30 PM
• Prizes for first deer, heaviest, widest rack and most points
• "People take their kids out of school for it." (Kayla Moore)
➜ TAKE: Some towns have a parade. Mancelona has a pole full of bucks.
➜ BAIT: Biggest deer your family ever got, and how much has the story grown?

3) NORTHPORT'S MILL POND IS GOING AWAY
• The pond has been there since the 1930s
• Voters said no to about $2 million to fix the dam
• The plan is to take the dam down and let the creek run natural
• No timeline yet, and some feelings are hurt over the fishing derby
➜ TAKE: Ninety years of pond, gone with one vote.
➜ BAIT: Got a Mill Pond or fishing derby memory?

━━ NATIONAL ━━

4) HUMPBACK WHALE IN THE HUDSON
• It was breaching off the West Village yesterday, by Piers 40 to 45
• Gotham Whale wants photos to ID it
• It might still be in the harbor today
• Not a first: 272 NYC whale sightings back in 2018
➜ BAIT: Seen anything wild on Grand Traverse Bay?

5) THE DOBERMAN WHO KNEW 🔊
• Saraya the Doberman wouldn't leave baby Alexander's side
• His heart was racing at 280 beats a minute
• It's a treatable heart condition, and he's doing great now
• Saraya isn't a trained service dog. She just wouldn't quit.
🔊 CLIP: doberman-swns.mp3 (1:20)
IN: "I'm Kim Reynolds. This is Saraya."
OUT: "Yeah, he looks happy. Yes."
➜ BAIT: Has your dog ever tried to tell you something?

6) STREAMER AWARDS: SPEED THREE-PEATS 🔊
• IShowSpeed won Streamer of the Year for the third straight year
• He also won Best IRL and Best Series for his World Cup Tour
• Kai Cenat won 3, including Best Collab with Tyla
• Katie B also won 3
• Jynxzi is Gamer of the Year
• The show moved up from Nov 17 to get out of the way of GTA VI
🔊 CLIP: speed-english.mp3 (0:46)
IN: "And the winner is…"
OUT: "Thank y'all so much."
This is his English Best IRL speech, thanking his cameraman and team.
➜ BAIT: Whose house was cheering for Speed or Kai?

7) HOBOKEN: MOST WALKABLE CITY IN AMERICA
• Walk Score 97 out of 100
• Michigan's most walkable city is Hamtramck, at 82
➜ BAIT: Could downtown TC take Hamtramck's crown?

8) TEEN BUILDS A FREE APP FOR AUTISM CAREGIVERS
• Shashank Madala started at 15, with just one computer science class
• His app, Kora, helps caregivers read a child's emotions
• It's free and used by 700+ families in 12 countries
➜ BAIT: Know a caregiver or teacher who'd use this?

━━ BITS ━━
• First advisory of the year: who's driving like it's July, and who's crawling at 25?
• Deer opener at daybreak and the Lions at 9:30 Sunday: blind with one earbud, or skip one?
• The Petoskey jar: how many are in yours, and have you ever polished one?

━━ SPORTS ━━
• TONIGHT 7 PM: Kingsley (11-0) vs. Meridian (11-0), D6 regional final, streaming on NFHS
• SAT 3:30: Michigan at No. 18 Oregon (FS1)
• SAT 4:15: MSU (3-6) vs. Washington (5-4) (BTN)
• SUN 9:30 AM: Lions (6-2) vs. Patriots (5-4) in Munich (FOX)

mental.title: Mental Health Minute
mental.content:
Give Yourself the Ten Minutes

This morning's the first real lake-effect snow of the year, and with an advisory up until one this afternoon, a lot of us are about to find out the roads are slicker than our brains are ready for. When we're running late on a morning like this, our shoulders creep up around our ears and every slow car in front of us turns into a personal enemy, so the stress is already riding shotgun before we even get out of the driveway. Here's your move for today. Leave ten minutes earlier than you normally would, and when you get in the car, before you put it in drive, take three slow breaths while the defroster does its thing. Because you've got those extra minutes in your pocket, the slow drive stops feeling like an emergency and goes back to being just a drive. Then you get where you're going a little calmer, and the people around you get the better version of you too. That's your Mental Health Minute on Z93. Text me at 231-929-4487 and tell me how long your drive in took this morning.
mental.notes: Full script from the Fri Nov 13 Morning Rush Hot Sheet. Aimed at the adult in the driver's seat. Advice already fits today's advisory / sloppy-road weather. Do not invent extra claims.

offcharts.title: Off the Charts
offcharts.content:
SPONSOR (read first):
Z93 OFF THE CHARTS is brought to you by Schuss Mountain at Shanty Creek Resort. Trade your screen time for ski time at Northern Michigan's most authentic ski resort, where you can hit the face, take the scenic route through the glades, or send it in the terrain parks. More at shantycreek.com.

OFF THE CHARTS · Gigi Perez, "Sailor Song" (2024)

• Released July 26, 2024, on her own, after Interscope dropped her
• She wrote it in her bedroom, and the hook "kiss me on the mouth and love me like a sailor" came to her in the shower
• Recorded with one mic, stacking three vocals: left, right and center
• It blew up on TikTok first, with 75,000+ videos using it within a month of release
• No. 1 in the UK, Ireland and Latvia. In the UK it knocked off Sabrina Carpenter, who had held No. 1 for 21 weeks.
• Here in the US it only got to No. 22 on the Hot 100
➜ THE ANGLE: No. 1 overseas, and America left it at 22
➜ BAIT: Did you find this one on TikTok or on the radio?
📱 231-929-4487
offcharts.notes:
Backup: Pearl Jam, "Black" (1991). The band refused to release it as a commercial single, even after Epic pushed them, because Eddie Vedder thought the song was too personal. It still reached No. 3 on Billboard's Mainstream Rock chart and No. 20 on Alternative Airplay — and it never hit the Hot 100. Official audio (5:46): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qgaRVvAKoqQ Optional live, MTV Unplugged (5:41): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pOM-h-bCHVA
Not repeats: earlier Off the Charts used/suggested picks were The Paradox "Bender" (played Oct 23), plus Jamiroquai "Virtual Insanity" and Coldplay "The Scientist" (suggested Nov 6, play not confirmed).
Source: /workspace/morning-rush/national-headlines-2026-11-13.md
Alt sponsor read (older version): Z93 OFF THE CHARTS is brought to you by Shanty Creek Resorts. When it's time for you to enjoy the wide-open spaces of Northern Michigan, check out Shanty Creek Resort, with over 275 lodging options, 42 downhill ski and snowboard runs, and plenty of outdoor fun.
TODAY'S PICK (Truce): Gigi Perez facts: Wikipedia (Sailor Song), Official Charts (UK No. 1, Nov 1 2024, ended Sabrina Carpenter's 21 weeks), Billboard (Hot 100 debut at No. 98; peak No. 22 per Chartify). ⚠ Lyric heads-up: "I don't believe in God / But I believe that you're my savior." It touches the no-religion rule, so check your edit.

bit-trivia.title: BIT: This Day
bit-trivia.content:
THIS DAY · NOV 13

• 1956 (70 yrs ago): the Supreme Court ends Montgomery bus segregation, in the Rosa Parks case
• 1940 (86 yrs ago): Disney's Fantasia premieres. Disney invented a stereo system just to play it.
• 🎂 Jimmy Kimmel turns 59
• 🎂 Steve Zahn turns 59
• 🎂 Whoopi Goldberg turns 71

➜ BAIT: Which Fantasia scene still lives in your head?
📱 231-929-4487
bit-trivia.notes:
Credit: Supreme Court Historical Society (Browder v. Gayle); D23 / Disney Archives (Fantasia premiere, Nov 13, 1940); UPI's Nov 13, 2026 famous-birthdays list (Kimmel, Zahn, Goldberg).
PRODUCER FLAGS: Fantasia premiered on this date; it was not a normal wide release (Fantasound meant it opened in only 14 theaters at first). The Court affirmed the ruling on Nov 13, 1956, in a short per curiam decision; the boycott ended Dec 20 after the city complied. No official, rights-clean Fantasia or Kimmel clip was confirmed — keep this as a talker.
